intro: Bailor Stonehand is a skilled dwarven smith residing in Thelsamar within Loch Modan. Renowned for his metallurgical expertise, he once mentored the human weaponsmith Jordan Stilwell and produces a specialized alloy crucial for masterwork armaments. Currently, his forge work faces setbacks after local Mo'grosh ogres ambushed and stole his ore shipments.

p: Operating in the dwarven settlement of Thelsamar, Bailor Stonehand represents the enduring craft of Loch Modan's blacksmiths. Known for his keen eye for raw minerals and his ability to smelt specialized alloys, Bailor's knowledge extends beyond Khaz Modan. He served as a mentor to the renowned human smith Jordan Stilwell, teaching him the foundational arts of metallurgy and sharing formulas that would later prove essential in forging blessed paladin armaments such as Verigan's Fist.

Despite his quiet mastery, Bailor's trade is not immune to the rising threats in Loch Modan. Shipments of high-grade ore destined for his forge have fallen prey to the Mo'grosh ogres entrenched in the hills to the northeast. Without raw materials, Bailor finds himself unable to craft his rare alloys, forcing him to rely on passing travelers and allies to reclaim his stolen supplies from the brute encampments.
